calculation.description: At each completed daily bar, rank the negative same-day open-to-close return cross-sectionally; higher values indicate weaker intraday performance and a reversal expectation for the next close return. Signal uses only the completed bar and predicts close[t+1]/close[t]-1.

validation.regime_notes: Positive and stable across 2020-2022 (IC 0.04811, ICIR 0.14286), 2023-2024 (0.05281, 0.16212), and 2025-2026 (0.04801, 0.14229). Small 15-asset universe warrants conservative uncertainty interpretation; high overlap with residual reversal is documented.
